breakfast.name: Strapatsada (Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes and Feta)
breakfast.description: Traditional Greek scrambled eggs with juicy tomatoes and creamy feta cheese, embodying the Greek philosophy of quality ingredients over complexity
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat
Add chopped tomatoes and cook for 10-15 minutes until moisture evaporates and tomatoes become jammy
Crack eggs into the pan and gently scramble into the cooked tomato mixture
Cook for 3-4 minutes until eggs are set but still creamy
Season with dried oregano, salt, and pepper
breakfast.notes: The key is not to overcook the eggs - they should remain creamy and not rubbery. Use ripe, flavorful tomatoes for best results
breakfast.fun_fact: Strapatsada reflects the Greek breakfast philosophy: focus on quality, fresh ingredients rather than quantity. This dish has been enjoyed in Greece for generations
alternatives: Add sautéed peppers along with tomatoes
Add fresh herbs like dill or parsley
Include pan-fried saganaki (fried cheese) on the side
